title: Where a production/experimental maturity tier exists, promotion must be an explicit config change, not a GUI action or an automatic decision
requirement: For a Clank whose collector/source registry distinguishes production (finalized) from experimental/soak maturity, moving a collector/source from experimental to production MUST be an explicit, out-of-band configuration change (e.g. editing an allowlist file and committing/deploying it) — not a button click in the GUI, and not an automatic promotion triggered purely by runtime metrics (soak duration, success count, etc.). This requirement only applies where such a maturity concept exists at all; a Clank with no experimental/production distinction is not in scope.
rationale: Independently articulated, not merely copied, in both a SKU-family and a news-family Clank: watch-clank's collector_registry.py documents an explicit 2026-08-27 'operator closeout decision' to gate promotion this way, calling it 'a second, independent gate at the eligibility layer' and warning not to rely on delivery-gating alone. korean-tech-wire has its own promotion-policy.md with its own reasoning ('not a reward for a small number of successful smoke runs'). tablet-clank, feature-phone-clank, and smartwatch-clank all implement the same allowlist-file mechanism. Keeping promotion out of the GUI and out of automatic logic keeps a human accountable for the decision, consistent with docs/governance.md's ratification-is-explicit principle applied at the collector level.
forbidden: A 'Promote to production' button in the GUI
Automatic promotion after N successful soak runs with no human action
Promotion criteria that live only in code comments, not in a reviewable config file
acceptance: Production membership is determined by a config file (allowlist or equivalent) under version control
No GUI route mutates that config file
No code path promotes a collector automatically based purely on runtime metrics

evidence.summary: Documented 2026-08-27 operator closeout decision; SAFE_COLLECTOR_IDS = KNOWN minus EXPERIMENTAL, described as an independent eligibility gate.
Independent written promotion policy for a news-family Clank: promotion is explicit and reversible, not a reward for smoke-run success.
Same allowlist-file mechanism in three further SKU-family Clanks.

notes: Pass 1 candidate. Family: Both, but conditionally scoped — chinese-tech-wire, semiconductor-intelligence, and smartphone-clank have no maturity-tier concept at all and are simply out of scope for this rule, not in violation of it.
